svg.title: JDBC findById Lookup Sequence
svg.desc: Sequence diagram rebuilt from JdbcRepository.findById/findByIdOrNull source, JDBC README method table, and repository lookup tests.
svg.text: findById requires exactly one row; findByIdOrNull maps an optional row and returns null when absent.

g.text: This is a sequence diagram: the same SELECT path feeds findById and findByIdOrNull.
findById throws when no row exists; findByIdOrNull returns null without calling the mapper.
